# DSSential

> DSSential is a local-first, open-source decision-analysis workbench. Its supported core provides
> validated transparent forecasting and bounded arithmetic scenario previews. AI narration is
> optional and is never authoritative for calculations.

- Repository: https://github.com/Sparkience-AI/DSSential-The-AI-Chief
- README: ./README.md
- Privacy and data flow: ./PRIVACY.md
- Security policy: ./SECURITY.md

Supported facts:
- Forecasts require real, unique, ordered, regular timestamps plus a confirmed frequency and unit.
- Models are compared with time-ordered rolling validation against naive baselines.
- Forecast intervals are empirical holdout error bands, not guarantees.
- Scenarios are arithmetic previews, not predicted outcomes or Monte Carlo risk models.
- Cloud narration requires a user API key and explicit provider-specific consent.

Not supported: causal inference, autonomous decisions, arbitrary code execution, Monte Carlo
outcome simulation, VaR/CVaR, Sobol sensitivity claims, or optimization claims.
